drhp.business: Anant Raj Limited is an infrastructure company that has moved up the value chain from colocation infrastructure to building a sovereign cloud (Ashok Cloud) and an AI-ready cloud platform. The company is executing a full-funded expansion of its data centre capacity, while maintaining a net debt-free status and funding growth internally. Its operations are guided by three core principles: location, permission, and execution.
drhp.end_markets: India (NCR and Haryana)|Hyperscale and digital sovereignty clients
drhp.expansion: Anant Raj Limited is scaling its data centre and cloud services business through a phased capacity build-out. As of March 2026, the Company has operationalised 28 MW IT load across two campuses: Manesar (21 MW) and Panchkula (7 MW). A third campus at Rai, Sonipat, with a planned capacity of approximately 200 MW IT Load, has commenced work and will be operationalised in phases. The Company has also signed an MoU with the Government of Andhra Pradesh for a new 50 MW IT load data centre facility, expanding its footprint into South India.
